messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up — Orchid Labs quota change planned for next Mon (2025-05-06). We'll lower their soft daily cap from 2,000,000 -> 1,500,000 tokens while they migrate to Dedicated. Need coordinated comms: customer email, in-product banner, and AM ping. Can folks review the draft below and the proposed cadence?

Jamie Ortiz: Rollout window? AMs across PST/EST — prefer AM pings at 10am local. Also want to confirm whether this is soft cap only or enforced hard cap?

Alyssa Chen: Soft cap for now, we’ll keep alerts but not hard-block. If usage hits soft cap we want graceful throttling + guidance. Target SMTP send Mon 08:00 UTC so banners go live same time.

Ben Jacobs: Draft/cadence looks fine. Recommend 3-touch: initial email (T-3 days), reminder (T-1 day), day-of nudge. Include explicit "what to expect" bullets and escalation path. I can draft the email copy.

Ravi Patel: Metrics to surface in the email: 7d avg, 30d avg, highest single-day, and top 3 routes by token usage. I pulled quick numbers: 7d avg ~ 1,210,000; 30d avg ~ 850,000; peak 1,950,328 (last Wed). Also flag any error spike correlated with latency — nothing obvious last 30d. I'll attach charts.

Alyssa Chen: Awesome — please include a small chart in the email showing trend + a CTA to request quota bump or Dedicated consult. Draft copy (please iterate):

```
Hi team — quick note that we will temporarily lower your soft daily token cap from 2,000,000 to 1,500,000 on 2025-05-06 08:00 UTC while we complete your Dedicated capacity rollout. Most customers see no disruption; if your usage approaches the new cap we'll send automated notices and your AM will reach out. If you need an accelerated Dedicated timeline or a temporary bump, reply to this email or click the "Request assist" button in the Console.

Why: safety margin during migration + to avoid unexpected throttling.
What to expect: automated warnings at 80%, soft throttling at the cap, and AM outreach if sustained.
Questions? Contact your AM (Jamie Ortiz) or reply to this message.
```

Jamie Ortiz: Suggest small addition to CTA: link to a scheduling calendar and a short FAQ anchor. Also add "if you have scheduled heavy batch jobs, please reschedule to off-peak" line.

Ben Jacobs: I'll take the email + subject lines: 1) "Notice: Temporary daily quota change — Orchid Labs" 2) short subject for reminder: "Reminder: quota change in 24h". Will share copy in #templates after a pass.

Ravi Patel: I'll export per-route charts and the cost delta table. One ask: include the expected spend impact estimate for a 25% drop in throughput — customers care. I will attach a CSV.

quota-bot: SYSTEM: scheduled limit change created (id: qc-1189) — effective 2025-05-06T08:00:00Z. Notification workflow: email draft pending -> banner draft pending -> AM checklist pending.

Alyssa Chen: Ok assignment: Ben — email + subject lines, Jamie — AM ping script + banner text + calendar link, Ravi — charts & CSV, I'll run final QA and send T-3. Please review before EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Jamie Ortiz: Will schedule AM pings and leave the calendar block template in #cs-ops.

Ben Jacobs: Sending first draft in 2 hours, will link here.

Ravi Patel: Uploading charts now to the thread (link) and will attach CSV to the email draft.

Alyssa Chen: Perfect — thanks team. We'll do a dry-run send to internal test list on Fri.

Ben Jacobs: +1 on dry run.
__notes: Single-thread Slack export style: chronological messages in one string. No title field per agents.md. All timestamps are Unix seconds.
